'''Noren M'Shar''' is the third largest city in [[Seanchan]].

It is located on the southern shore of the [[Seanchan (continent)|Seanchan continent]].{{ref/book|bwb}} According to [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag|Tuon]], omens will always mean the same, if it is in [[Imfaral]] or Noren M'Shar.{{ref/book|9|14}}
